atlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game character sprite atlas on a genuinely transparent background for LAST CONVOY. Reference 1 is STYLE ONLY: gritty hand-painted Vietnamese supernatural apocalypse, inked silhouettes, muted olive, aged leather, amber edge lighting, not photographic. Reference 2 provides Minh's face/identity. Output a wide landscape sprite sheet, exactly FIVE equal-width columns and TWO equal-height rows, all ten cells isolated with clear transparent gutters. Same full-body scale and feet baseline in each cell, no overlaps, entire boots/weapons visible. Columns left to right: (1) Minh, Vietnamese male leader late 30s, short black hair, worn olive jacket and scarf, a battered steel crowbar; (2) Bao, Vietnamese stocky mechanic late 50s, grey stubble, battered olive work cap, leather apron over olive jacket, a heavy wrench; (3) Lan, Vietnamese female medic early 30s, dark hair tied back, olive coat and canvas red-cross medical satchel, syringe/medical device; (4) Hunger raider, thin hunched male with hood, cracked gas mask, dark ragged leather coat, rusted machete; (5) Watcher raider, tall lean masked male in long charcoal coat, goggles and battered rifle. Friendly characters in columns1-3 face right; raiders4-5 face left. Upper row: combat-ready idle full-body poses. Lower row: the SAME five characters in a dynamic attack/cast pose (crowbar swing, wrench swing, medic extending green healing device, machete slash, rifle firing). Match outfit/face and proportions exactly between rows. Maintain cell centers at 10%,30%,50%,70%,90% width and row centers25%,75% height, individual sprites fully within their cells. No background, NO floor, no cast shadows, no UI, no numbers, no labels, no text, no borders, no logos or watermarks. Transparent alpha around all figures and between cells.
stage: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a production BACKGROUND PLATE for a 2D side-view turn-based combat game LAST CONVOY. Reference is STYLE AND CAMERA only, do NOT reproduce its characters, labels, meters, icons or UI. Wide 16:9 landscape, gritty hand-painted graphic-novel Vietnamese supernatural apocalypse, inked worn surfaces, midnight teal and warm amber with subtle red distant embers. Scene: abandoned evacuation market loading courtyard at rainy night, tarpaulin stalls and old concrete shop houses behind. A battered olive armored passenger bus at FAR LEFT BACKGROUND, nose aimed right toward center; a spiked rusted raider delivery truck at FAR RIGHT BACKGROUND, nose aimed left. Keep vehicles behind combat plane, no people whatsoever, no silhouettes of humans. Large continuous readable clear wet asphalt stage across the center and lower third, with low perspective horizon and subtly painted reflected amber headlights. Empty ground at front for five interactive full-body sprites. Background architecture softly hazed, stage floor not excessively busy, rain fine not obscuring. Foreground corners slight dark vignette, center open, leave top and bottom with calm areas for DOM HUD overlays. NO text, NO signs with writing, NO UI, NO numbers, NO logos, NO watermark. Fully painted illustration matching the reference, not photorealistic or 3D render.
combatMusic: Create an original instrumental tactical combat soundtrack for LAST CONVOY, a dark supernatural survival convoy game set in a rain-soaked abandoned Vietnamese market at midnight. 90 seconds, 88 BPM, D minor. Tense restrained percussion with heavy low toms and scrap-metal hits, pulsing low bowed strings, breathy wooden flute fragments, ominous distant bronze bell, subtle broken-radio static. Gritty cinematic graphic-novel atmosphere; determined survivors, approaching occult danger. Start immediately with a quiet steady pulse, maintain a consistent combat intensity and clear space for game sound effects. No singing, no vocals, no chanting, no spoken words. No abrupt ending, fade out gently so we can edit into a repeating gameplay loop. Avoid heroic orchestral fanfare, EDM drops and recognizable melodies. Title: Last Convoy — Market After
